methods.label: Interpret subtraction as change
methods.explanation: You pay with 10 yuan for a purchase costing 3.6 yuan and receive 6.4 yuan in change.
methods.levelReason: A change illustration uses elementary part-and-total reasoning and one-place decimal subtraction, both within Grade 4.
